name: 陳盈竹
objective:
本課程為全英語授課 EMI，討論及簡報均需以英語呈現。
色彩的運用在各類設計領域中皆扮演關鍵角色。本課程將介紹色彩理論的基礎，並循序深入探討色彩的基本應用與互動心理。透過案例分析與分組實作活動，學生將更深入理解色彩應用背後的邏輯與思考方式。
課程將以實作為核心，輔以電腦繪圖工具，呈現色彩之間的互動關係。在基本原則的引導下，學生可發揮創意於作品中，展現色彩的互動性與視覺效果。

The application of color plays a crucial role in various design fields. This course will introduce the basics of color theory and progressively cover foundational applications of color and interactive psychology. Through case studies and group hands-on activities, students will gain a deeper understanding of the logic behind color application.
The course will primarily focus on hands-on practice, supplemented by computer graphics to present the interactive relationships between colors. Within basic guidelines, students will infuse creativity into their work, showcasing the interactions and effects of colors.
schedule:

Week 2: Basic Concepts
Week 3: Structure of Colors
Week 4: Relativity of Colors
Week 5: Gradient Study
Week 6: Opposing Background Colors
Week 7: Subtractive Colors
Week 8-9: Color Book Review
Week 10: Visual Afterimages
Week 11: Applications of Color Mixing
Week 12: Volume of Color
Week 13: Color Psychology
Week 14-16: Artwork Analysis
Week 17-18: Final Book Submission
